body:
## Summary

`UiNode::replace_virtual_collection_items` searched for the target collection by passing `items.clone()` to every child it visited. Each virtual realization therefore deep-copied the whole realized item map once per node that precedes the collection, then dropped all the copies. A scroll step cost (nodes before the collection) × (realized items).

This PR moves the map out of an `Option` only at the matching collection; nodes on the way receive nothing.

## Evidence

- **Real app** (oh-my-byted, 1,650-row NativeCollection-backed Table in a widget with a toolbar, tabs and header before it), `sample` of the main thread over 20 s of continuous scrolling:
  - `realize_virtual_requests`: 51.5%, of which `replace_virtual_collection_items`: 31%
  - `BTreeMap::clone`: 41%, `UiNode::clone`: 35%, the matching drops: about 28%
  - the table scrolled at about 40 fps before this change and 60+ fps after it (user-observed with the app's fps badge).
- **Headless** (0.1.7, release, `ScriptLifecycle`, NativeCollection Table nested after 80 sibling nodes; one step = shift the window by 3 rows and realize 28; median of 40 steps):

  | rows | before | after |
  |---|---|---|
  | 1,652 | 7.60 ms | 1.46 ms |
  | 20,000 | 7.60 ms | 1.18 ms |

## Regression test

`node::tests::realized_items_move_into_nested_collections_without_copies` builds three nested layouts: siblings before the collection, the collection inside an `ErrorBoundary`, and a preceding subtree without a collection. It asserts that the realized item arrives as the same allocation that was passed in, using the heap address of a `String` attribute. Without the fix it fails with `layout 0: realized items were copied`. It is deterministic, has no timing, and uses no `unsafe`.

## Checks run locally (on this branch)

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- `cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features`: 593 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo test -p gpui-rhai --lib --locked`: 428 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo test --manifest-path tests/performance/Cargo.toml --locked`: 2 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo doc -p gpui-rhai --all-features --no-deps`

Not run locally:
- `tests/native-keyboard`: needs an idle desktop session.
- The visual baseline audit: needs screen recording permission on this machine.
- `cargo package`.

## Not included

We also tried two follow-ups against the remaining one-frame blank rows when flinging:
- waking the host pump from `request_target` instead of waiting for the 16 ms frame poll;
- a configurable Table `overdraw_pixels`, set to 600 px.

In the real app the blanks remained and the frame rate got worse. Presumably each realization is still a whole-view transaction (root clone, full reconcile, semantic frame rebuild), so running it more often and realizing more rows costs more than it saves; this was not profiled. Both were dropped. A real fix for the blanks probably needs incremental realization first.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
